DOCUMENT 1 — Tuesday trains from Eastford to Milltown
Train A: departs 8:00 a.m.; arrives 9:15 a.m.; seats available.
Train B: departs 8:30 a.m.; arrives 10:20 a.m.; seats available.
Train C: departs 9:00 a.m.; arrives 10:05 a.m.; fully booked.
Train D: departs 9:35 a.m.; arrives 11:00 a.m.; seats available.

DOCUMENT 2 — Booking email thread: Priya’s request
I cannot leave Eastford before 8:15 a.m. My appointment is near Milltown station, and I must arrive at the station no later than 10:30. Please reserve a train that meets both conditions. I do not want to rely on a waiting list.

Booking agent’s reply
I reserved the only available train that fits your times. The fare is NT$180. You may cancel without a fee until thirty minutes before departure; later cancellations are not refundable. Your ticket is attached. Please arrive at the platform at least ten minutes before the train leaves.

A 車：08:00 出發，09:15 抵達，仍有座位。
B 車：08:30 出發，10:20 抵達，仍有座位。

文件二——訂票往返郵件：Priya 的請求
我不能在上午八點十五分前離開 Eastford。我有約，地點靠近 Milltown 車站，但我最遲必須十點半抵達車站。請訂同時符合兩條件的班次，我不想靠候補。

訂票人員回覆
已訂好唯一符合時間且有座位的班次，票價新臺幣一百八十元。最遲於發車前三十分鐘取消，不收手續費；逾期取消則不退款。車票已附上，請至少提前十分鐘到月台。
